solver_notes: Metadata mismatch disclosed: crossbeam-rs/crossbeam is Rust and has no net/socket/epoll_server.c; this is a Linux C server issue. The patch adds a portable epoll server registration helper and C11 MPSC accepted-fd queue. EPOLLEXCLUSIVE is applied to one shared nonblocking listener registered in every accept worker epoll instance, eliminating accept thundering-herd wakeups. SO_REUSEPORT clarification: distinct reuseport sockets have distinct wait queues and kernel-hash distribution; EPOLLEXCLUSIVE does not coordinate those separate queues. The tested fix therefore uses a shared listener, not a false cross-reuseport guarantee. The lock-free MPSC queue uses atomic tail exchange and release-link publication; the single dispatcher consumer advances the head and reclaims stubs. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field set to the empty string; the transmitted payload SHA is separately computed over final bytes.
